title: divergence pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

species.errorMessage: Species name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fasta.errorMessage: Protein FASTA file must be provided, cannot contain spaces, and must have extension '.fa', '.faa' or '.fasta'. Gzipped input is not supported: OrthoFinder cannot read it

cds.errorMessage: Nucleotide CDS FASTA must be provided, cannot contain spaces, and must have extension '.fa', '.fna' or '.fasta'. Gzipped input is not supported. Record IDs must match the protein IDs in the corresponding 'fasta' file exactly.
